shots.detail_en: Dawn close-up: a mop sweeps the empty trading hall floor, wet strokes drawing rising candlestick chart lines on the tiles
shots.sub: 旁白（长虹）："洗盘结束的第七天，我的本金满了六位数。"
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Insert: father's 1993 hand-drawn notebook open in the storeroom, three hand-drawn candle marks ticked off in red
shots.sub: 长："爸，第二次，又中了。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Wide: opening bell, crowd floods in, retail traders step aside and offer cigarettes to the young sweeper
shots.sub: 散户甲："虹哥，今天看哪边？" 长："看自己的单子。"
shots.speaker: 散户甲/CH

shots.detail_en: Close-up: teller Hongli slides a prediction slip signed 'Lu' under her glass counter, fingertip tapping the character
shots.sub: 红："连中七天……运气不会写字，字迹会。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Triple quick cuts: Man Cang running errands with breakfast boxes / Hongli stacking trade receipts / Chang Hong dusting under the giant board
shots.sub: 旁白："满仓跑腿，红利睁眼，我扫我的K线。"
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Wide: the flip board turns green again, worried crowd gathers and stirs
shots.sub: 散户乙："又要跌穿了！"
shots.speaker: 散户乙

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Chang Hong scans the board, checks his one-minute-slow pocket watch
shots.sub: 长（低语）："这不是第二跌——是同一根K线的尾巴。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: after close, Chang Hong leaves a second folded prediction slip on Hongli's glass counter and walks off; she looks up, he is already mopping
shots.sub: 无

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Hongli unfolds the slip and lays it beside handwriting on the back of an old photo in her drawer, comparing strokes
shots.sub: 红："同一个'陆'字，最后一笔都在抖。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: Chang Hong pulls out his trade slip, principal column freezes at six digits; Man Cang leans in, eyes bulging
shots.sub: 满："哥！本金成了！现在全仓梭哈不？" 长："先让本金学会站着，再教它跑。"
shots.speaker: MANCANG/CH

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: VIP mezzanine, Xiong Tiancheng raises a brass telescope and locks onto the sweeper in the corner
shots.sub: 熊（自语）："七天的单子，比我的自营盘还准。"
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Extreme close-up: the prayer beads on his wrist stop turning
shots.sub: 熊："扫地工不赌运气——他赌的是，我知道什么。"
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: Xiong Tiancheng summons his assistant and hands over a commission note
shots.sub: 熊："去查。这个'陆先生'——底细、来历、十年前的户口。"
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Close-up: the assistant's notepad writes two characters plus a question mark: '陆先生?'
shots.sub: 无

shots.detail_en: Wide explosive: closing board confirms Chang Hong's tail-wave call, green flips to a flood of red devouring the screen
shots.sub: 散户群："又是那根尾巴！拉了——"
shots.speaker: 散户群

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: the crowd turns to find 'that sweeper' — only a mop stands in front of the giant board (iconic scene reprise)
shots.sub: 满："他就是陆先生！"
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Close-up: the words 'LU SIR' ripple and enlarge through speech bubbles over the crowd (dramatic kinetic type)
shots.sub: 散户群（回声）："陆先生……陆先生……"
shots.speaker: 散户群

shots.detail_en: Two-shot: at the counter Hongli taps the 'Lu' character on the slip and looks up at Chang Hong
shots.sub: 红："陆先生——你姓陆，还是姓'六位数的陆'？" 长："姓我父亲的陆。"
shots.speaker: RED/CH

shots.detail_en: Night, Xiong's office: a kraft-paper investigation report lies on the desk, cover stamped only with '陆', unopened
shots.sub: 熊："先别翻。真相，要配最贵的开盘价。"
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Xiong Tiancheng presses his prayer beads down onto the report cover, smile unmoved
shots.sub: 熊："这个市场里，最贵的不是钱——是来历。"
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Black screen with next-episode card
shots.sub: 字幕："来历，是查出来的，也是等出来的——沈红利的抽屉里，还压着一张照片。"
shots.card: 来历，是查出来的，也是等出来的——沈红利的抽屉里，还压着一张照片。
